senses.gloss:
m. (-तः)
1 A name of VIṢṆU; also of KṚṢṆA, as a form of VIṢṆU.
2 A shrub (Morinda tinctoria.)
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Fixed, permanent.
E.
अ neg. and च्युत participle of च्युङ to go.

m. (-सः)
The religious fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.)
E.
अच्युत VIṢṆU, वास abode.

m. (जः)
1 A name of BALARĀMA, the elder brother of KṚṢṆA.
2 A name of INDRA.
E.
अच्युत KṚṢṆA as VIṢṆU, and अग्रज elder born.
